source_claim: VOCALOMAKETS' official WORKS page has a dedicated 結月ゆかり product table and groups the named releases across VOCALOID4 (純/穏/凛), VOCALOID6 AI, VOICEROID2, A.I.VOICE/A.I.VOICE2 (including 雫 and 凪), VoiSona/CeVIO AI 結月ゆかり 麗, and other software versions under the same 結月ゆかり character heading. The creator's official character-use guideline identifies 結月ゆかり as a character operated and developed by VOCALOMAKETS and directs software products to their separate license terms.
notes: The page's official WORKS table is headed 結月ゆかり and maps all eight packet members to editions/voice forms of that character; independent AHS official Yukari product page confirms VOCALOID4 凛 and 穏 forms. No HOME_COPYRIGHT is asserted: this catalog evidence documents joint character/product stewardship and multiple synthesis engines, while project policy warns that an engine/platform qualifier alone is not a HOME. Reference: https://vocalomakets.com/guidelines and https://www.ah-soft.com/yukari/.
